title: Azure governance as code
summary: Azure rules for many clients from one repository, with approvals and no secrets.
lead: Azure rules for many clients, managed from one place and with approval.
problem: Applying security and cost rules to each client by hand is slow, hard to audit and easy to break.
idea: Write the rules once, version them and apply them across clients after an approval, without storing passwords anywhere.
change: It's the foundation of a reusable governance service at Readymind. In advanced development.
role: I designed the architecture to run many clients from one repository, built the flow that requires approval before each change and the passwordless authentication.
note: I show the what and the why. Code and client data stay inside Readymind.
